newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya Commercial Bank boosts Nairobi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Kenya Commercial Bank boosts Nairobi bourse.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Friday on the back of strong activity in Kenya Commercial Bank, brokers said.
The index rose 8.21 points to stand at 3035.33. Turnover was posted at 7.538 million shillings on 220,919 shares compared to 5.725 million shillings on 199,478 shares on Wednesday.

"There was no trading on Thursday as it was a public holiday. But today (Friday) saw good trading as most players returned to the market focusing their interest mainly on the Kenya Commercial Bank, which was the best traded counter," an official said.
Commenting on the volume traded in Kenya Commercial Bank, a broker said there was panic buying for the few shares floated on the market in the bank's latest primary public issue.
The government is selling another 10 percent of its shareholding in Kenya Commercial Bank, closing next Tuesday. The bank traded 53,021 shares up 4.0 shillings at 59.00 shillings.

Another broker said there were bids to buy huge lots of Kakuzi and Sasini Tea & Coffee but there were no offers for them. National Bank of Kenya traded 32,300 shares at 15.50 from 15.70, Standard Chartered Bank rose to 45.75 from 44.50.
